checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Large shocked human face on right
must.why: Big face, wide eyes, open mouth, hands on cheeks, headset.

must.item: Headline exactly ONE LAST TRY, no extra words
must.why: Three lines, spelled correctly, no other text.

must.item: Headline on left, high contrast, not covering face
must.why: Yellow with black outline on blue; clear of the face.

faults.what: Low resolution (640px wide) versus the 1280x720 recommended.
The 'LAST' text slightly touches the left edge of the face/headset area; the bottom of 'TRY' is close to the frame edge.

summary: A punchy thumbnail with correctly spelled yellow "ONE LAST TRY" on the left and a big shocked headset gamer on the right; the only real issue is the low 640px resolution.
